versions.changelog:
Initial release of AI Running Coach!

- 提供基于 VDOT 理论和周期化训练的专业马拉松训练指导
- 支持个性化训练计划生成、配速和心率区间计算
- 能分析跑步数据（TCX/GPX）、并给出训练建议
- 帮助制定比赛配速与补给策略，以及训练/伤病等常见问题咨询
- 参考主流跑步科学理论，包括 VDOT、极化训练和周期化训练

- Initial release of AI Running Coach based on Jack Daniels’ VDOT theory and periodized marathon training.
- Provides personalized marathon and half-marathon training plans.
- Supports pace/heart rate zone calculations, race strategy, and performance analysis from TCX/GPX files.
- Offers training Q&A, injury prevention advice, and performance prediction.
- Includes command-line tools for pace calculation, plan generation, and run data analysis.
